The first pinned OMP reviewer spawn from the linked PM worktree was refused before a peer existed. Prime inspected the native guard: it rejects any git-dir path containing a worktrees component, not an observed collision in this repository. Relative file-tool read and shell pwd both identified the clone. These prove launch/root/registration/message controls, not an independent provider-served model or material-effort attestation. The peer made no product edits and ran no tests; review remains unreleased.

Also exposed DD writer constraints: new sections require structural seeding; blocked state and its required note must be written together.

A piped harness plan validate --complete --json returned exit 0 with 65536 bytes ending mid-JSON. File-backed capture returned all 91712 bytes and parsed; after the ownership repair it returned 95898 bytes. Prime reproduced the pipe boundary, identified output/exit.ts calling process.exit before pipe flush, and owns the fix with a pipe-boundary test. Until it lands, harness JSON is captured to regular scratch files and read afterward; no truncated complete result is called green.

The accepted first-class Builder initialization scope authorizes portable harness-owned creation; adoption records external ownership without re-allocation, and teardown cannot remove resources the allocator did not create. allocation.owner remains explicit. This records the existing authorization and its clarified boundary, not a new human ratification.

The first revised seal has not been issued; all six coders remain explicitly paused, original receipt bytes remain unchanged, tk-0001 assertions and all 19 ACs remain unchecked. A final committed guide/fixture delta will be reviewed before resealing or refreshed acknowledgements. Packet, Ack and Dispatch share the unit/source-SHA identity scheme; the fresh nonce remains an independent anti-replay field. Missing or wrong-qualified records and current-name/wrong-source payloads must refuse instead of authorizing from old records. Unit-scoped locks serialize every baseline attempt. The PTY fixture explicitly does not claim CI-mode rendering coverage.
